design: red hoodie; white/red headscarf; silver chains; black wide cargo; large black lug boots; no glasses
resolutionRule: standing character must have >=500px visible height; crouched/airborne/lying poses preserve anatomical scale rather than being individually enlarged
integrationNotes: Existing spriteAlias is evaluated before dedicated strips, so some supplied dedicated moves will be masked until aliases are reviewed separately.
anim.js uses p for the renderer; cyclic states can use all ten cells. Several held states map only to selected cells. Ten supplied cells do not guarantee ten cells displayed in every game state.
FX are separate supplied art; render/fx.js currently uses procedural effects. No FX integration was performed.
